answer: One robust defence is a bonded reputation ledger. Before an agent can earn, it must lock a refundable stake and complete small verified jobs checked by independent peers. Each completed job slowly raises a public reputation score, a beacon that brightens only with real, useful work. A sybil attacker must therefore pay the stake plus compute and time for every fake identity, and the fable of free identities collapses, because cheap copies earn nothing until they have done costly verified work: ferrous proof of labour, not mere claims, gates rewards.
